render_configuration.rendering_library: OpenCV raster drawing and PNG encoding; WFDB waveform decoding
render_configuration.layout: 12 aligned rows; all 10 seconds of each lead; no rhythm-strip duplication
render_configuration.gain_policy: Fixed 2.5 mm/mV for every page; points beyond the 30-mm lead row are clipped to its edge and counted
render_configuration.printed_text: Lead names and fixed technical calibration only; no patient ID, ECG ID, demographics, dates, SCP code or diagnostic label
render_configuration.label_policy: All present SCP-code keys mapped through diagnostic==1; no likelihood threshold. Five overlapping binary targets. Records without mapped diagnostic superclasses retained as images but excluded from the classification manifest.
render_configuration.split_policy: Official patient folds: 1-8 train, 9 validation, 10 test. Every source ECG rendered once; no split search or class balancing.
render_configuration.preview_policy: Development only: first training record for each diagnostic superclass plus deterministic training amplitude extremes; freeze style after visual and numerical checks before full generation.
render_configuration.randomness: None; deterministic clean rendering. No random augmentation or model training.
render_configuration.limitations: Synthetic clean ECG pages, not real scans or photographs. Rasterization is not lossless signal storage: 500-Hz source points share pixels at 200 horizontal pixels/second. Native waveforms remain the authoritative numerical signal. Page-wide gain can vary and is explicitly calibrated; low-gain and flat-lead records are flagged, not silently discarded.
